movies.overview: A thrilling ghost story set in Dickens' London, following one man's supernatural journey to face his past, present and future as he fights for a second chance at redemption.

movies.title: Godzilla Minus Zero
movies.overview: Direct continuation of Takashi Yamazaki's Godzilla Minus One.

movies.title: Wild Horse Nine
movies.overview: CIA agents Chris and Lee face a trust-testing mission from Santiago to Easter Island during 1973 in Chile.

movies.title: The Mongoose
movies.overview: A highly decorated combat vet, Ryan ''Fang'' Flanagan, is fleeing a murder scene at 130 miles an hour in a Mustang Shelby Super Snake GT350

movies.title: Wicker
movies.overview: An ostracized fisherwoman commissions the local basketmaker to weave her a husband, but when her wicker creation proves unexpectedly extraordinary, his presence ignites jealousy and upheaval that threatens their quiet village.

shows.title: Crystal Lake
shows.overview: Prequel series to Friday the 13th, follows a doomed small town where camp counselors come to die.

shows.title: VisionQuest
shows.overview: Vision is faced with many challenges while trying to regain his memory and humanity.

shows.title: Below
shows.overview: When a mysterious sea creature terrorizes a remote town, a fisherman must fight to protect his family, his community, and his way of life.

shows.title: Carrie
shows.overview: After her father's sudden death, sheltered teenager Carrie White, raised by her domineering mother, enters public high school, where she faces a viral bullying scandal and the awakening of mysterious telekinetic powers.

shows.title: East of Eden
shows.overview: In the farmlands of the Salinas Valley in California, successive generations of two families, the Trasks and the Hamiltons, are destined to reenact the fateful story of Cain and Abel.

anime.title: Devils' Crest
anime.overview: Sixth-grader Yuuma Ashihara and his twin sister, Sawa, are playing Actual Magic, a brand-new virtual reality MMORPG, when it suddenly begins fusing with the real world. Amid all th…

anime.title: DARK MACHINE THE ANIMATION
anime.overview: Following his grandfather’s will to “seek out the Senki,” the protagonist Kairi visits Golden Valley, a special Dark Machine economic zone. There, he meets a mysterious girl named Rudra.…

anime.title: Chitose Is in the Ramune Bottle 2nd Cour
anime.overview: The second part of Chitose-kun wa Ramune Bin no Naka .

anime.title: Ace of the Diamond act II -Second Season-
anime.overview: Sequel to Diamond no Ace act II: Second Season .

anime.title: Mission: Yozakura Family Season 2 Part 2
anime.overview: The second cour of the second season of Yozakura-san Chi no Daisakusen .
